name: Pyromancer: Purifying Flames adds 3 s to Essence of Malygos (#859)
contract: #859: Essence of Malygos 802120 lasts 6000 ms (DBC duration idx 32). Purifying Flames 807159 is a passive SPELLMOD_DURATION (misc 1) +2999+1 = +3000 ms on class mask C 0x1, which selects 802120. Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies it (SpellAuras.cpp:812). Asserts the native duration modifier applied to 6000 ms is 6000 before and 9000 after learning the passive.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Purifying Flames adds 3 s to Essence of Malygos
